title.en: Endocrine glands, hormones and the hypothalamus

hook.en: Nerves are like a phone call: fast and to one person. Hormones are like a letter posted to the whole state: slower, but they reach every cell that has the right letterbox.
hook.kn: ನರಗಳು ದೂರವಾಣಿ ಕರೆಯಂತೆ: ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ. ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ ಪತ್ರದಂತೆ: ನಿಧಾನ, ಆದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಅಂಚೆಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಇರುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶವನ್ನೂ ತಲುಪುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Name the endocrine glands of the human body
Explain how the hypothalamus controls the pituitary

narration.en: Nerves are like a phone call: fast and to one person. Hormones are like a letter posted to the whole state: slower, but they reach every cell that has the right letterbox.
narration.kn: ನರಗಳು ದೂರವಾಣಿ ಕರೆಯಂತೆ: ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ. ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ ಪತ್ರದಂತೆ: ನಿಧಾನ, ಆದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಅಂಚೆಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಇರುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶವನ್ನೂ ತಲುಪುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Neural coordination is fast but short-lived, and nerve fibres do not reach every cell, so cellular functions need continuous regulation by a special kind of coordination: hormones. The neural and endocrine systems together coordinate and regulate the physiological functions of the body. Endocrine glands lack ducts and are called ductless glands; their secretions are hormones. Hormones are non-nutrient chemicals that act as intercellular messengers and are produced in trace amounts. Invertebrates have very simple endocrine systems with few hormones, while vertebrates have many chemicals acting as hormones. The organised endocrine bodies in humans are the pituitary, pineal, thyroid, adrenal, pancreas, parathyroid, thymus and gonads (testis in males and ovary in females). Some other organs, such as the gastrointestinal tract, liver, kidney and heart, also produce hormones.
body.kn: ನಾಳರಹಿತ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳೇ ಅಂತಃಸ್ರಾವಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳು; ಅವುಗಳ ಸ್ರಾವಗಳು ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು. ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಪೋಷಕವಲ್ಲದ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕಗಳು, ಅಂತರಕೋಶೀಯ ಸಂದೇಶವಾಹಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅತ್ಯಲ್ಪ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿ, ಪೀನಿಯಲ್, ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್, ಅಡ್ರೀನಲ್, ಮೇದೋಜೀರಕ, ಪ್ಯಾರಾಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್, ಥೈಮಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜನನಾಂಗ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳು ಮುಖ್ಯ.

narration.en: The teacher compares neural and hormonal coordination, maps the endocrine glands and shows how the hypothalamus controls the pituitary.

say.en: Nerves are fast but short-lived and do not reach every cell. Hormones are slower, last longer and reach every cell through the blood.
Here are the organised endocrine glands of the human body, from the head down.
The hypothalamus controls the pituitary. Releasing and inhibiting hormones reach the anterior pituitary through a portal system; the posterior pituitary is controlled directly by nerves.

body.en: The hypothalamus is the basal part of the diencephalon (forebrain) and regulates a wide spectrum of body functions. It has several groups of neurosecretory cells called nuclei, which produce hormones that regulate the synthesis and secretion of pituitary hormones. These are of two types: releasing hormones, which stimulate secretion of pituitary hormones, and inhibiting hormones, which inhibit it. For example, gonadotrophin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulates the pituitary to synthesise and release gonadotrophins, while somatostatin from the hypothalamus inhibits the release of growth hormone from the pituitary. These hormones originate in the hypothalamic neurons, pass through axons, are released from their nerve endings and reach the pituitary through a portal circulatory system to regulate the anterior pituitary. The posterior pituitary is under the direct neural regulation of the hypothalamus.
body.kn: ಹೈಪೋಥಲಾಮಸ್ ಮುಮ್ಮಿದುಳಿನ ತಳಭಾಗ. ಅದರ ನರಸ್ರಾವಕ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಬಂಧಕ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸಿ ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. GnRH ಗೊನಾಡೋಟ್ರೋಫಿನ್ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಸೊಮಾಟೋಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಟಿನ್ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಿಂಭಾಗದ ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿ ನೇರ ನರ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

points.en: Releasing hormones (e.g. GnRH) and inhibiting hormones (e.g. somatostatin)
Reach the anterior pituitary through a portal circulation

problem.en: A scientist blocks the portal blood vessels between the hypothalamus and the pituitary. Predict the effect on (a) the anterior pituitary and (b) the posterior pituitary.

steps.en: Hypothalamic releasing and inhibiting hormones reach the anterior pituitary through the portal circulatory system.
(a) With the portal vessels blocked, the anterior pituitary no longer receives GnRH, somatostatin and other regulators, so its secretion is disturbed.
(b) The posterior pituitary is under direct neural regulation by the hypothalamus through axons, so it is not directly affected.

answer.en: Anterior pituitary control is lost; posterior pituitary control (neural) is largely unaffected
